criticality.rationale: Broken coordination authority can misattribute work and enable conflicting effects; only read-only diagnosis is eligible.

stpa.rationale: Unsafe claims, absent registrations, stale evidence and effects beyond a hold must fail closed.

fmea.rationale: Evidence laundering or false identity is S5 O4 Det3, RPN60 with severity floor5; analyst estimates, not measured rates.

dependency.rationale: Identity and valid coordinator authority are prerequisites for safe all-system MCP operations.

impact.rationale: One truthful inventory and common coordination boundary cover external agents, internal actors and system services.

fmea_modes.cause: Multiple incompatible histories and declarative participants mistaken for live authenticated membership.
fmea_modes.effect: Wrong-worker attribution, unsafe parallel effects and false all-systems-available claims.
fmea_modes.controls: Preserve evidence; separate identities and models; reject invalid replay; Sa-plan-only task operations; independent cutover review.
